units.age_quote: the Ainoyama: ca. 20 Ma (middle Early Miocene)
units.lith_quote: composed of dacitic lava and conglomerate
units.unit_description: The Ainoyama Formation is composed of dacitic lava and conglomerate, originating from volcanic activities.
units.desc_quote: The Ainoyama Formation is composed of dacitic lava and conglomerate. On the basis of their ages and distributions, they have been originated from the different volcanic activities.

units.lithology: welded rhyolitic pumice lapilli tuff, conglomerate, sandstone, and mudstone
units.lith_quote: composed of upper welded rhyolitic pumice lapilli tuff and lower conglomerate, sandstone, and mudstone
units.basal_quote: unconformably covers the Jurassic strata and the Cretaceous plutonic rocks
units.unit_description: The Nisatai Formation is composed of welded rhyolitic pumice lapilli tuff, conglomerate, sandstone, and mudstone, deposited unconformably over older strata.
units.desc_quote: The Nisatai Formation is composed of upper welded rhyolitic pumice lapilli tuff and lower conglomerate, sandstone, and mudstone. This formation is non-marine deposits, and unconformably covers the Jurassic strata and the Cretaceous plutonic rocks.

units.lith_quote: lithologically characterised by two facies; monzogabbro and quartz monzonite. The monzogabbro facies consists mainly of medium-grained quartz monzogabbro with biotite, clinopyroxene, orthopyroxene, hornblende, and olivine. The quartz monzonite facies consists of medium grained biotite hornblende quartz monzonite
units.unit_description: The Ichinohe Pluton consists of monzogabbro and quartz monzonite facies, intrusive in age.
units.desc_quote: The Ichinohe Pluton is lithologically characterised by two facies; monzogabbro and quartz monzonite.

units.lith_quote: composed of medium-grained biotite hornblende granodiorite
units.unit_description: The Tsukanaigawa Pluton is composed of biotite hornblende granodiorite, intrusive in age.
units.desc_quote: The Tsukanaigawa Pluton is composed of medium-grained biotite hornblende granodiorite.

units.lithology: phyllitic mudstone and pelitic mixed rock, with blocks of mafic rock, limestone, chert, siliceous mudstone, and sandstone
units.lith_quote: consists mainly of phyllitic mudstone and pelitic mixed rock, accompanied by blocks of mafic rock, limestone, chert, siliceous mudstone, and sandstone
units.unit_description: The Kuzumaki Formation consists mainly of phyllitic mudstone and pelitic mixed rock, with blocks of various lithologies, deposited in an accretionary complex setting.
units.desc_quote: The Kuzumaki Formation consists mainly of phyllitic mudstone and pelitic mixed rock, accompanied by blocks of mafic rock, limestone, chert, siliceous mudstone, and sandstone.

units.lithology: sandstone, chert, siliceous mudstone, slaty mudstone, and laminated silty mudstone
units.lith_quote: consists mostly of sandstone, with chert, siliceous mudstone, slaty mudstone, and laminated silty mudstone
units.unit_description: The Kassenba Formation is characterized by repetitions of chert-clastic sequences, consisting mainly of sandstone with associated lithologies.
units.desc_quote: The Kassenba Formation is characterised by at least two repetitions of chert-clastic sequence, and consists mostly of sandstone, with chert, siliceous mudstone, slaty mudstone, and laminated silty mudstone.

units.lithology: slaty mudstone, laminated silty mudstone, chert, siliceous mudstone, and sandstone
units.lith_quote: characterised by at least three repetitions of chert-clastic sequence, and consists mainly of slaty mudstone and laminated silty mudstone, accompanied by chert and small amount of siliceous mudstone and sandstone
units.unit_description: The Seki Formation is characterized by repetitions of chert-clastic sequences, consisting mainly of slaty mudstone and laminated silty mudstone with associated lithologies.
units.desc_quote: The Seki Formation is characterised by at least three repetitions of chert-clastic sequence, and consists mainly of slaty mudstone and laminated silty mudstone, accompanied by chert and small amount of siliceous mudstone and sandstone.

units.lithology: dismembered sandstone, mudstone, slaty mudstone, chert, siliceous mudstone, and mafic rocks
units.lith_quote: consists mainly of alternating beds of dismembered sandstone and mudstone, and slaty mudstone with small amount of chert, siliceous mudstone, and mafic rocks
units.unit_description: The Takayashiki Formation consists mainly of alternating beds of dismembered sandstone and mudstone, with slaty mudstone and minor chert, siliceous mudstone, and mafic rocks.
units.desc_quote: The Takayashiki Formation consists mainly of alternating beds of dismembered sandstone and mudstone, and slaty mudstone with small amount of chert, siliceous mudstone, and mafic rocks.
